elements.value: Effective March 1, standard advisory fees drop to 0.60% across all client tiers.
Granite View Group is reducing standard advisory fees to 0.60% for 2026, effective March 1. The change applies across institutional, commercial, and individual client tiers.

This quarter introduces updated pre-trade checks and revised escalation paths. Desk heads must confirm completion by the end of the month.
